note: Corps of Engineers campground on a wooded point of Lake Barkley near Eddyville, with a swimming beach, fishing dock and playground. The drive-in sites ring one loop; sites 19-23 and 25-31 line the shore, and six walk-to tent sites sit along the beach side. --Claude
summary: Kept; lakefront CONFIRMED. Fees 30 -> 30-32. 45 drive-in RV sites (+6 walk-to), 50A + water, max 78 ft. Showers/laundry. Season 04-30..10-24 (new). Reservable on rec.gov, max stay 14. Pin OK, phone OK.
flags: WATERFRONT CONFIRMED lakefront: on leaf-on Esri imagery sites 19 (36.917734,-87.977246), 20 (36.917833,-87.977011), 22 (36.917885,-87.976817) and 23 (36.917915,-87.976633) sit on open mowed grass that slopes straight to the shore, with no road, parking or tree screen between (the loop road is behind them). Lidar: summer pool (109.4 m) reached at 21 m / 3.0 m below (19), 30 m / 2.6 m (20), 24 m / 2.1 m (22), 21 m / 2.1 m (23) - gentle grass banks of about 6-8 degrees, passing the kayak test. Site 27 (36.917579,-87.976006) is 18 m from the water but 2.7 m above over a short tree-lined bank (view-type); 25 and 29 are behind trees. All are electric RV sites sold by the night on recreation.gov (sites 19-20, 22-23 at the $32 premium rate).
